title: Corrigendum to `Evaluation of motivic functions, non-nullity, and integrability in fibers', Advances in Mathematics, Vol. 409, Part A, Paper No. 108635, 29 pages, doi:10.1016/j.aim.2022.108635 (2022)
summary: We correct the statements and proofs of the (auxiliary) Propositions 4.1 and 4.2 of our paper `Evaluation of motivic functions, non-nullity, and integrability in fibers' in Advances in Mathematics, Vol. 409, Part A, Paper No. 108635, 29 pages (2022), and we explain how the proofs of the main results can be adapted to work with those corrected propositions.
